theme_and_archetype.reasoning: Healthcare requires warmth, trust, and calm (Earthy/Organic). However, 'Quick Commerce' requires a perception of extreme speed. The UI will use a grounded base (warm sand, bone white) with a highly kinetic, unnatural accent (Electric Coral) to draw attention to ETA and booking actions. This tension (calm base vs. kinetic accent) fulfills the E1 anti-pattern.

brand_identity.emotion: Relief and Speed. The user should feel the anxiety drop the moment they open the app, knowing help is minutes away.

brand.primary_description: Deep Forest Green. Used for navigation, trusting elements, doctor names.
brand.accent_description: Electric Coral (The Twist). Used sparingly for ETAs, live tracking paths, and the final 'Request Visit' CTA.

typography.strategy: The Soft Utility pairing. A modern humanist sans-serif for headings that feels friendly yet precise, and a highly legible geometric sans for the body.
rules: No generic Inter or Roboto for headings.
Labels must be uppercase and widely spaced.
Headlines must use tight letter spacing.

spacing_and_layout.system: Tailwind RN standard via NativeWind or StyleSheet metrics.
rules: Generous spacing: Let elements breathe. If standard is p-4, use p-6.
Avoid 100% width buttons in cards unless necessary. Use asymmetrical padding.
Containers with borders must have internal padding (p-6) to prevent text collision.

buttons.primary: bg-[#FF4F40] text-white rounded-full. Sharp, high contrast.
buttons.secondary: bg-[#EAE7E0] text-[#123524] rounded-full. Low contrast, earthy.
buttons.states: Must have explicit styling for active/pressed states (opacity 0.8 or scale down 0.98).

cards.style: Neumorphism (Tactile) variant. bg-[#FFFFFF], shadow-sm, border border-black/5. Crisp inner contrasts.

inputs.style: bg-[#F8F7F4] border border-[#EAE7E0] rounded-2xl p-4. Focus state must have high contrast border (#123524).

navigation.style: Bottom tab bar must float above content. rounded-full, glassmorphism if supported (blur), otherwise solid white with shadow.

RoleSelector.layout: Massive typography. Split screen or bento layout for Patient vs Doctor. Use the onboarding_bg image for patient side.
RoleSelector.focus: Establish trust and clarify intent instantly.

PatientDashboard.layout: Bento Grid protocol (Tetris mode adapted for mobile).
elements: Quick Action: AI Symptom Checker access.
List: Recent visits or active status.
PatientDashboard.vibe: Calm, minimal friction. The CTA should pop with Electric Coral.

LiveTrackingMap.layout: Full screen map view with floating bottom sheet.
elements: Floating Sheet: ETA, Doctor Profile summary, Contact buttons.

DoctorProfile.layout: Editorial layout. Large avatar, clear credentials.

AISymptomChecker.layout: Chat interface. Differentiate user/AI bubbles with shape, not just color.

motion_and_interactions.strategy: Micro-interactions for delight. Reanimated/Moti for fluid layout transitions.
rules: Staggered entrance animations for list items.

testing_attributes.rule: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.

onboarding_background.description: Minimalist 3D medical cross integrated with a fast moving trail, soft organic sage green and terracotta colors.
onboarding_background.usage: Role selector or main patient dashboard background.

mock_map_background.description: High-end abstract top-down map view of a city neighborhood in clay render style.
mock_map_background.usage: Live ETA tracking screen background (mock map).

doctor_portraits.usage: Doctor profile avatar, trust & safety screens.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the color palette and typography rules specified.
Use standard React Native components (View, Text, TouchableOpacity, ScrollView, FlatList).
For icons, use @expo/vector-icons (Lucide or Phosphor preferred).
Do NOT use web-specific HTML tags or Shadcn UI components. Adapt the styling paradigms to standard React Native or NativeWind.
Use the provided image URLs to prevent placeholders.
